decision: Accept the exact dated articles for local source integration; production acceptance remains pending

records.determination: One New Port development crossing Busan and Changwon. The 2023 demonstration account and April 2024 opening remain separate. Component automation, operator energy claims and inland connections do not establish whole-programme completion or comparable performance.

One municipal area, not the wider region or complete New Port footprint. TABARA pilot, rollout and extension dates remain distinct; neighbourhood planning, forecast travel time and scheduled park activities are not citywide operating outcomes. Mixed-date population data is excluded.

One municipality/city-state rather than the metropolitan region. Adaptation adoption, U5 construction and future service, HVO100-fuelled freight pilot and airport-station observations retain distinct claims. No district double count or zero-emission whole-chain assertion.

review_checks: Fifteen primary-source records inspected November 22 in America/Edmonton. Relevant article bodies, date labels and stage distinctions were read; search snippets were discovery aids.

English text was read directly. One Korean speech and four German sources were interpreted by Codex and self-reviewed under owner policy, not independently reviewed or admitted as additional translated readings.

Three articles provide eighteen substantive sections, thirteen chronology events and three next-artifact requests each. Five sourced sections and one editorial evidence-test section per article keep assertions and proposed observations distinct.

Busan New Port crosses Gangseo-gu and Jinhae-gu. The 1995 project-period start is not an invented exact groundbreaking date; Terminal 7, broader port activity and future Jinhae development are not additional counted identities.

The October 30, 2023 ministry page retains future tense for an October 27 demonstration. The April 5, 2024 speech date is an event date with publication unknown. Neither a demonstration nor an opening establishes ongoing reliability.

Remote berth cranes, guided vehicles and automated yards describe functions, not a workerless system. Operator electrification and shore-power descriptions are not measured whole-chain emissions. Undated operator design-capacity figures were omitted.

Busan's district page has conflicting population-period labels; population was not imported. TABARA's month-only dates remain months. The expressway's February 9 ceremony, February 10 service account and forecast journey savings are distinct. Park schedules are not attendance receipts.

Hamburg's seven districts are nested in one city-state. Autumn 2022 remains year precision with the season stated; the May 2026 U5 preferred-route decision is not an opening. Prospective trials and passenger service remain forecasts.

The HVO100 boat and electric final-mile bikes retain different energy boundaries. Airport weather observations remain station-specific and derived from the city press account, not an inspected raw dataset. Citizen waterway reports supplement official measurements.

Prior identities and route records were screened. Original acquisition inputs, earlier exact-version reviews, the 103 historical determinations, all 34 readings and the current evidence ledger are retained.

Local integration adds one project and two places. It does not add a cycle gate, admit a comparable outcome series, authorize publication or launch, or complete production verification and stewardship.
